name: Kimpton Los Monteros Marbella
positioning: Kimpton resort in the Los Monteros neighborhood east of Marbella on the Costa del Sol, reimagining the historic Los Monteros hotel
best_for: Travelers who want pools, a spa and a beachfront club on the Costa del Sol

facts.text: The Los Monteros neighborhood, where the hotel sits, is east of the city of Marbella.
Marbella is on Spain's Costa del Sol and is known for its warm climate and beaches.
The rooms were designed by Cristina Carulla's interior studio and use natural light as a fundamental part of the Mediterranean experience.
The main pool is surrounded by gardens at the Costa Club Pool Bar, with hammocks, Bali beds, live music and DJs.
The Maison Codage Paris Spa offers facial and body treatments.
The Racket Club has tennis and paddle courts to rent, and a personal trainer service is available.
Jara, the hotel's fine-dining restaurant, is inspired by Marbella in the 70s.
The hotel welcomes any pet that fits in its elevator, and pet accommodation is free of charge.
The hotel holds a BREEAM Very Good sustainability certification.
The hotel offers a complimentary cocktail hour.
There are children's activities on site.
The protected Artola Dunes are about 8 kilometers from the hotel.

highlights.text: The Escondido rooftop has an infinity pool with views of the Mediterranean.
La Cabane by Dolce&Gabbana is a beachfront space designed by Dolce & Gabbana, with food by chef Dani Garcia and private sunbeds and cabanas.
The Maison Codage Paris Spa has a heated indoor pool with hydro-massage beds and water cascades.
Kimpton Los Monteros Marbella reimagines the historic Los Monteros hotel and its lively past.

considerations.text: Malaga Airport is approximately 35 kilometers from the hotel.
WhataHotel notes that central Marbella's dining and nightlife require a short trip from the resort.
